title: Pointwise Marginal Treatment Effect Rates under a Shrinking Propensity Support
banked_reason: D0.5.G: tier=subfield below floor=field; paper_score_ceiling 7.1 < 7.4, salvageable=false, with no bounded same-scope repair.
gap_reasons: The exact three-regime frontier is proved only for the oracle experiment in which the propensity scores are observed.

For feasible estimation, the note establishes the consistency boundary, conditional oracle-attainment regions for beta at most one, and a strict scalar separation, but it leaves the central feasible minimax rate unresolved: the lower exponent 29/280 does not match the available upper exponent 9/100.
Honest feasible point and band widths, higher-order attainment for beta greater than one, and the general smoothness-dimension phase diagram also remain open.
The unresolved feasible frontier and absence of a developed application or numerical demonstration constrain the leading-journal score.

The D0.5 repair triage left three local caveats unresolved: the identification proof uses an undeclared outcome-envelope assumption and integrates outside the stated domain; the clipped oracle interval lacks a nonempty fallback/radius convention; and the oracle-band decision class, simultaneous coverage, and width loss are underspecified.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived the oracle point-risk and honest-band phase diagrams, the exact feasible consistency boundary, two beta-at-most-one attainment regions, and a folded paired-mixture witness separating feasible and oracle risk. The field-tier program collapsed because the feasible lower and upper exponents did not match and the feasible inference/general-smoothness frontier remained open. D0.5 triage stopped before three local correctness and decision-class defects were repaired, so future reuse must audit those items rather than treating the note as final.
tldr: How fast can a pointwise MTE be learned when the known propensity range \([p_0-\kappa_n,p_0+\kappa_n]\) genuinely shrinks, \(\kappa_n\to0\), and the map from instruments to propensity is an unknown, possibly highly folded Hölder function? This paper establishes the exact three-regime oracle minimax and oracle-honest frontiers, the exact \(n\kappa_n^2\) feasible-consistency boundary, constructive oracle attainment for \(0<\beta\leq1\) by fixed-partition IV in the support-limited regime and by localized IV in the interior regime when the displayed first-stage scale is negligible relative to the oracle bandwidth, and a strict feasible--oracle separation with an honest-radius lower bound. The exact nuisance frontier, matching feasible honest widths, higher-order corrected-score theory, and the unknown-endpoint experiment remain open; widths bounded away from zero are quarantined in a fixed-support oracle benchmark.
gap: The closest work either fixes a regular propensity design, studies generated covariates without a genuinely shrinking derivative experiment, treats weak identification in a different triangular model, or targets integrated/finite-dimensional MTE functionals. The supplied calculations support a strict feasible-oracle gap in one rough scalar shrinking-width subcase but leave lower exponent \(29/280\) unmatched by the current upper exponent \(9/100\).
fill: Prove matched minimax upper and lower bounds over \((\beta,\gamma,d_z,\kappa_n)\), exact oracle-attainment conditions for feasible moments, and matching honest-radius results with explicit fallback; then solve endpoint localization as a distinct moving-target experiment.
